PLAN "Post-Meniscus Return to Skiing - 12 Week Strength"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Rebuild lower body strength for skiing return"
  GOAL secondary strength:
    name "Restore unilateral leg stability and control"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation and Control" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body Stability":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          glute_bridge 2x12
          bird_dog 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body Push":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 2x12
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          tricep_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Lower Body Unilateral":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
          leg_swings 1m
          glute_bridge 2x12
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          figure_four_stretch 1m
          calf_stretch 1m
      DAY Saturday training 50m "Upper Body Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
          scapular_retraction 2x12
          prone_Y 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds

          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 1m
